quests.title: Wanmin Fresh

dialogue.sit: I have other things to do.

dialogue.t: Sure. I'll find someone else to help...
Thanks a lot, you're a big help.
Make sure you keep a good grip on this Jewelry Soup, and be careful while you're delivering it. Make sure not to knock it over, and make sure you don't glide, or it'll all spill out.
Oh yes — and don't touch anything weird, or the flavors will get all mixed up...
Now, hurry and deliver that Jewelry Soup. It won't be any good once it gets cold.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Tacit Tingfang

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Yes, that's correct. A while ago, a customer named Tingfang ordered a bowl of Jewelry Soup from me. He paid in advance, saying that he wanted it delivered to the Dunyu Ruins.
I still need to man the restaurant, so I don't have time to make the delivery. It would be great if you're willing to go in my place.

quests.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
